name: SME Profitability Analysis
description: A bounded, all-agent business analysis with deterministic financial calculation, advisory contributions, explicit review, durable artifacts and a saved decision.

context_policy.review_context_compression: Remove markdown structure, retain concise conclusions, hashes and status.

tasks.prompt: Evaluate the three supplied scenarios. Recommend the strongest path, explain why, and give two measurable stage gates. Do not invent external market data.
Create a six-week implementation sequence for the recommended path. State dependencies, owners from the registered-agent list, and measurable acceptance gates.
Compare the three scenarios on monthly profit, margin and downside risk. State which is strongest and whether explicit disagreement or escalation is required.
Assess whether the business can execute the combined scenario within existing capacity. Identify one capacity constraint and one sequencing safeguard.
Define the evidence needed before converting these hypothetical scenarios into real business commitments. Keep the hypothetical label explicit.
Audit the supplied figures conceptually. State which values are provided assumptions, which are derived, and what evidence is missing for real-world use.
Propose a concise report structure covering baseline, scenarios, recommendation, risks, verification and evidence.
Check whether the supplied monthly data is sufficient for the baseline. List required units and the most important missing real-world field.
Calculate total monthly expenses, monthly profit and net margin from the supplied revenue and expense lines. Show arithmetic and compare with the deterministic baseline.
Assess the revenue-lift and inventory-saving assumptions. Provide one downside case and explain how it affects the recommendation.
Check units, arithmetic, percentage denominators and rounding. Return PASS or FAIL for the baseline and each scenario with reasons.
Define operational controls for a staged inventory and marketing programme, including monitoring cadence, stop conditions and evidence to retain.
Design the minimum durable artifact and evidence structure for this workflow. Explain how inputs, agent jobs, handoffs, outputs and the saved decision remain auditable.
Specify essential fields and invariants for a machine-readable results file that lets a reviewer reproduce totals and compare scenarios.
Write exact acceptance tests for baseline arithmetic, scenario reproducibility, JSON consistency, all-agent evidence and persisted memory.
Define a safe test proving a saved project decision survives backend restart, including evidence before and after restart and failure handling.
Give the commercial judgment on the recommended scenario versus the alternatives. Identify the most important cash or operating constraint and the preferred implementation order.
Rank the scenarios by incremental monthly and annual profit. State the key assumption behind each ranking and one downside risk.
Produce the top five risks of the recommended scenario with one mitigation and one measurable warning indicator for each.

Independently review the completed phase-one analyses and deterministic calculations. Identify unsupported claims, conflicting advice and material omission. Return PASS, PARTIAL or FAIL with findings.

Act as release gate. Decide whether the workflow outputs are ready for delivery based only on phase-one results, the quality review and the deterministic checks. Return PASS, PARTIAL or FAIL and list blockers.
